title: ZATCA Wave 25: Saudi E-Invoicing Phase 2 Deadline 1 Feb 2027
headline: ZATCA wave 25: *deadline 1 Feb 2027*
source_line: Sources: ZATCA news 24 Jul 2026, ZATCA e-invoicing guidelines, Zoho Books help
caption_fix: one hundred eighty seven thousand five hundred riyals
description:
ZATCA wave 25: taxpayers whose revenue subject to VAT exceeded SAR 187,500 in 2022, 2023, 2024 or 2025 must integrate their e-invoicing solution with the Fatoora portal by 1 February 2027. Phase 2: standard (B2B) tax invoices are cleared by ZATCA before they are shared with the buyer; simplified invoices are reported within 24 hours. Full Zoho Books setup video on the channel.

Sources (checked 15 Nov 2026):
- ZATCA: https://zatca.gov.sa/en/MediaCenter/News/Pages/Wave25-E-invoicing.aspx
- ZATCA guidelines: https://zatca.gov.sa/en/e-invoicing/introduction/guidelines/documents/e-invoicing_detailed__guideline.pdf
- Zoho Books help: https://www.zoho.com/sa/books/help/e-invoicing/phase-2.html

General information, not tax advice. Always check the latest ZATCA notices.

beats.text: Wave 25: revenue subject to VAT above SAR 187,500 in 2022-2025

lines: Saudi Arabia's tax authority, ZATCA, has named wave twenty five of e-invoicing Phase 2.
If your revenue subject to VAT went above one hundred eighty seven thousand five hundred riyals in any year from 2022 to 2025, you are in.
Your deadline to integrate with Fatoora is the first of February 2027.

beats.text: B2B cleared first · B2C reported in 24 h
OTP, CSID, then Push to Fatoora

lines: Phase 2 means business invoices are cleared by ZATCA before you send them, and consumer invoices are reported within twenty four hours.
In Zoho Books, you connect with a one time password from Fatoora, then push each invoice to Fatoora.
